minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  June 14, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:30 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes, Human Resource
  Stephanie Maldonado, Parks and Rec
  Dominique Ybarra, Finance

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of May 24, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. United Site Services of California, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing portable restrooms and sinks during construction at Rogers Park in the amount of
  $5,008.28. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Monjaras & Wismeyer Group, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing services to the Human Resource Department in the amount of $2,790.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

4. Magnolia Environmental, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services of
  asbestos testing for the City in the amount of $575.00. Motion carried unanimously.

5. Mc Murry Stern – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services of removing the
  non-operable lektriever in the City Clerk’s Office in the amount of $3,960.01. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:40 a.m. Adjournment
